failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the Pipelines service prevented it from initializing, causing all start attempts to fail and resulting in the Pipelines failing to start.

original_source: Some users may experience delays in receiving email notifications

original_source: Degraded website performance for some customers.

original_source: Bitbucket pipelines showing error when running a build.

original_source: Bitbucket - Steps are queued and delayed from starting

failure_pattern: An internal backfill job executed a high-volume, resource-intensive query set against the primary database, causing the database to become overloaded and trigger an automatic failover. original_source: Some pipeline builds are not triggering
